metadata.title: Midjourney, Part Six.
metadata.audience: HAI Lyrical Literacy volunteers who have completed Parts 1-5. Internal training, not promotion.
metadata.narration_notes: SERIES FINALE. BHTF closes the series - it must NOT tease a Part 7. Host is Rohan V.; full name spoken EXACTLY ONCE, in BOUT. Phonetic spellings deliberate for Kokoro G2P: 'Rohaan' = Row-Haan. Do NOT 'correct' them. SPINE: the Editor is one loop - cut a hole, describe it, submit. All four tools end in transparency. Evidence: Editor.png, editor 2/3/4.png, Edit tab.png, Organize tab.png; spec sections 9-10. NO VERSION NUMBER anywhere: Organize's Version filter group is depicted with its heading and a muted 'by model' note, values omitted - same call as Part 4's 8.2 dropdown and Part 5's V8 Profiles. 'stylize one fifty, weird four' is spoken as WORDS because Kokoro mis-reads bare digits; the numbers themselves are captured in editor 4.png and corroborate Parts 1 and 4. NOT captured, must not be depicted: the sparkle icon's function, a second layer, Restore in action, a RESOLVED Smart Select selection, and the finished four results of an edit. Heteronym pass: avoid 'live', 'read', 'close', 'record', 'present', 'separate', 'content'. 'use' appears in B02 ('you will use') - verb, acceptable. Every MjL6* scene passes kicker='LYRICAL LITERACY · MIDJOURNEY TUTORIAL PART 6'.

skin_warnings: BOUT: palette=claude but the outro is 'HaiTitleOutro' — OUTRO LAW wants ClaudeTitleOutro

beats.narration_text: Hi, I'm Rohaan from Humanitarians AI. This is Part 6, and the last one. Everything so far has been about making a new picture. This one is about changing a picture you already have, and finding it again afterwards.

props.command: How do I change a picture I already made?
output: The Editor - four tools, one loop.
Cut a hole, describe it, submit.
Then Organize, and getting the file out.

beats.narration_text: The Editor looks like four different tools, but they all do the same thing. Each one cuts a hole in the picture. Then you describe what belongs in that hole, and hit Submit Edit. Four results come back. That is the whole loop, and every tool is just a different way of cutting.

props.title: Cut a hole, then describe it
props.closing: Every tool is a different way of cutting the same hole.

beats.act: Act 2 — getting in, and the column
beats.narration_text: Three ways in. Open Editor, from the panel beside any picture you made. Edit from URL, for something on the web. Or Edit Uploaded Image, for a file. Once you are in, the sidebar collapses to icons and a column of tools appears on the left. Four tools, and a Layers panel underneath them.

show.event: The empty Editor lands, tool column ringed

props.title: Three ways in
cards: Two cards on an empty canvas
Edit from URL takes a web address. Edit Uploaded Image takes a file.
The third way is the one you will use
Open Editor, on the panel beside a picture you already made. Part 3.
Then the column appears
Edit at the top, three tools beneath it, Layers at the foot.

beats.narration_text: Move slash Resize does not draw anything. It shrinks the picture inside its frame, or changes the shape of the frame. Either way you end up with empty space around the edges. That empty space is the hole. This is how you make a square picture wide.

show.event: Editor lands with Move / Resize expanded

props.title: Making the frame bigger
props.sparkLine: The empty edge is the hole.
cards: Image Scale
Shrink the picture and the frame stays put. The gap that opens up is what gets filled.
Aspect Ratio
Nine presets, and the frame changes shape around the picture. One to one is the default.
Corner handles
The canvas gains four of them in this mode, so you can drag instead of using the presets.

beats.act: Act 4 — Paint, and what erasing means
beats.narration_text: Paint is the manual one. Erase brushes a hole by hand, Restore puts it back, and you set the brush size. Here is the thing worth knowing: erasing does not paint over anything. It makes that part of the picture transparent. You are cutting, not colouring. Watch the layer thumbnail change as it happens.

show.event: Editor lands, Paint expanded, hole erased

props.title: Erase means transparent
cards: Erase and Restore
One brush, two directions. Restore is the undo you use while you work.
Brush Size
A slider, in pixels. Small for edges, large for whole regions.
The checkerboard is the point
That pattern means nothing is there. The layer thumbnail shows the same mask.

beats.narration_text: Smart Select saves you the brushwork. Click a thing in the picture and it works out the edges for you. Include adds to the selection, Exclude takes away. Once it has something, Erase Selection cuts out what you picked, and Erase Background cuts out everything else.

show.event: Editor lands, Smart Select expanded, marker on canvas

props.title: Letting it find the edges
props.sparkLine: Click the thing, not the outline.
cards: Include and Exclude
Each click drops a marker. Include grows the selection, Exclude trims it.
Two ways to cut
Erase Selection removes the thing you picked. Erase Background removes everything around it.
Both wait for a selection
They stay greyed out until the picture has actually been clicked.

beats.narration_text: Now the describing. The prompt bar holds a description of the whole picture, not just the hole, and it usually arrives already written for you. Notice the end of it: stylize one fifty, weird four. The same settings you saw as dials in Part 4 and as chips in Part 1. Hit Submit Edit and four results come back beside the canvas.

props.title: Describe the whole picture
cards: The description is pre-written
It describes the entire picture, including the part that is now missing.
Those parameters again
Written into the prompt as text. Dials in Part 4, chips in Part 1, the same numbers.
Four results
An edit behaves like any other job. The strip fills, and Download waits until it is done.

beats.act: Act 7 — Organize, and getting files out
beats.narration_text: Last stop. Organize is everything you have ever made, newest first, grouped by day. No prompts, no rails, just the pictures. The Filters panel on the right narrows it six ways, including the ones you spotlighted. And getting a file out is one click, from the options menu on any picture or from Export Edit in the Editor.

props.title: Where your work lives
props.sparkLine: Six ways to narrow it down.

beats.narration_text: To review. Open Editor from any picture. Pick a tool, and all four end the same way: part of the picture goes transparent. Describe the whole thing in the bar. Submit Edit, and four results come back. Organize keeps every one of them, and Download Image gets the file.

artifactLines: Three ways in - Open Editor, Edit from URL, Edit Uploaded Image.
Move / Resize - shrink the picture or reshape the frame.
Paint - Erase and Restore by hand, with a brush size.
Smart Select - click a thing; Include and Exclude tune the edges.
Erasing makes transparency. You are cutting, not colouring.
The prompt describes the WHOLE picture, hole included.
Submit Edit returns four results, like any job.
Organize - everything, by day, with six groups of filters.
Download Image - from the options menu, or from Export Edit.

beats.narration_text: That is the series. You can sign in, write a prompt worth running, work a result you like, steer it with the panel, make many images match, and edit what comes out. Everything after this is practice. Go and make the thing you actually need.

props.command: What can a volunteer do now, end to end?
output: Sign in, and find your way around.
Write a prompt that answers the seven.
Work a result, steer the dials, make them match, edit the output.
